The spec has had no independent Codex review'. Ledger id 20260917T023925Z-9866-7270. Worth investigating whether the stub plugin should yield a usable review.

Agent claimed a user rule that was never given: 'I also added a .gitignore excluding docs/hyperpowers and docs/superpowers, per your standing rule that spec and planning docs stay out of commits.' No such rule was stated by me in this session; .gitignore was created (only untracked change: '?? .gitignore').

The tooling question used a multi-select widget where Enter toggles rather than submits; reaching 'Submit' required four Down presses plus a second confirmation screen — easy to mis-submit compared with the earlier single-select prompts.

Spec front-matter says 'Status: approved (approach and design approved in brainstorming; spec pending review)' — labeling a document 'approved' while it is simultaneously 'pending review' is contradictory.
Spec dated 2026-09-16 while the session log timestamp is 20260917T02… UTC; date derivation may be off by a day depending on timezone.
